title: Offload Media – Cloud Storage Pro v6.2.0
description: Manual QA catalog (unit-test style). Read Checking purpose first — it says what contract you are validating. Where / When are only how to observe it. Goals G1–G8 (and Env) map to release acceptance criteria. Mark Pass / Fail / Blocked / Skipped (use Skipped for N/A). If a Given precondition is missing, mark Blocked and say why. Fail severity: Blocker / Critical / Major / Minor. P0 first this release: Dashboard verification cards, Start Verification, Media Library statuses, delete-local safety, private downloads, WP-CLI, CSV reports. After opening Offload Media, use the plugin sidebar (not the WP left menu). Keep the browser console open (F12) and hard-refresh plugin admin pages with Ctrl+F5.

goals.title: Single lifecycle truth
goals.proves: One lifecycle state per attachment across all surfaces

goals.title: Verification detects cloud reality
goals.proves: Missing object after verify → Failed, not healthy offloaded

goals.title: URLs follow lifecycle
goals.proves: No broken cloud URL for Failed when local exists; private uses signed URLs

goals.title: Verification jobs are durable
goals.proves: Progress, pause/resume, survive navigation, no duplicate jobs

goals.title: Delete-local cannot bypass safety
goals.proves: Unverified offloaded files keep local copies when safety is ON

goals.title: Dashboard + CSVs are operational truth
goals.proves: Cards and exports reflect lifecycle, not legacy counters alone

goals.title: File Manager bulk ops are scoped
goals.proves: Only selected keys, complete honestly, report partial failures

goals.title: WP-CLI matches admin semantics
goals.proves: Same lifecycle counts and safety rules as the UI

goals.title: Environment / operator experience
goals.proves: Safe staging, correct build, screens load, clear errors

sections.title: 2. Dashboard — verification cards & reports

testCases.title: Dashboard loads
testCases.given: License valid, provider configured.
testCases.when: Open the page with console open.
testCases.then: Title Dashboard. No console errors. You see connection health plus media cards.
testCases.description:
Given: License valid, provider configured.
When: Open the page with console open.
testCases.expectedResult: Title Dashboard. No console errors. You see connection health plus media cards.
testCases.purpose: Primary admin entry point must load without JS errors so operators can see connection health and media summary.
testCases.failImpact: Operators cannot assess offload health or start verification from Dashboard.

testCases.title: Media summary cards show the right labels
testCases.when: Look at the eight cards.
testCases.then: You see exactly: 1. Library media — In WordPress Media Library; 2. Eligible to offload; 3. Offloaded — % of eligible; 4. Not offloaded — Remaining eligible to sync; 5. Local removed — Removed from server; 6. Verified — Cloud existence confirmed; 7. Awaiting verification — Offloaded, not yet verified; 8. Failed — Lifecycle / verify errors (or N retrying). Numbers feel roughly right vs Media Library (small lag is OK).
testCases.description: When: Look at the eight cards.
testCases.expectedResult: You see exactly: 1. Library media — In WordPress Media Library; 2. Eligible to offload; 3. Offloaded — % of eligible; 4. Not offloaded — Remaining eligible to sync; 5. Local removed — Removed from server; 6. Verified — Cloud existence confirmed; 7. Awaiting verification — Offloaded, not yet verified; 8. Failed — Lifecycle / verify errors (or N retrying). Numbers feel roughly right vs Media Library (small lag is OK).
testCases.purpose: Each card must map to a distinct lifecycle bucket so totals are interpretable (offloaded ≠ verified ≠ failed).
testCases.failImpact: Misleading counts (e.g. 27/27 offloaded while items are Failed) drive wrong delete-local decisions.

testCases.when: Read the banner. Click Verify Offloads.

testCases.description:
Given: Some files are Offloaded but not Verified (Awaiting verification > 0).
When: Read the banner. Click Verify Offloads.
testCases.expectedResult: Banner text is like: “N offloaded file(s) are awaiting cloud verification before local files can be safely removed.” Clicking Verify Offloads takes you to Bulk Operations (#bulk-operations), not a dead end. You can see Start Verification on that page.
testCases.purpose: Operators must be warned when local delete is unsafe and routed to Start Verification — closes the gap between “offloaded” and “confirmed on cloud”.

sections.title: 3. Bulk Operations — Start Verification
sections.description: P0. Durable Job Engine at the top of Bulk Operations. Related automated script: tests/cloud-verification.php.

testCases.title: Start Verification creates a job
testCases.where: Offload Media → Bulk Operations → card Durable Job Engine
testCases.given: At least one offloaded, unverified file. No Remove-from-cloud job running.
testCases.when: Click Start Verification.
testCases.then: Toast/notice: verification job started (or already running). A job row appears with Operation Verify offloads. Status moves waiting/pending → processing. Live line Verifying cloud objects can appear above the buttons. Progress shows like N / M verified (x%) — numbers move during the run, not only at the end.
testCases.description:
Given: At least one offloaded, unverified file. No Remove-from-cloud job running.
When: Click Start Verification.
testCases.expectedResult: Toast/notice: verification job started (or already running). A job row appears with Operation Verify offloads. Status moves waiting/pending → processing. Live line Verifying cloud objects can appear above the buttons. Progress shows like N / M verified (x%) — numbers move during the run, not only at the end.
testCases.purpose: Clicking Start Verification must enqueue work with visible progress — not a no-op or fake success toast.
testCases.failImpact: Metadata never updates; operators think verification ran.

testCases.title: Verification survives leaving the page
testCases.given: A verification job can be started.
testCases.when: Start Verification, then close the tab or go to Posts. Wait ~30–60s. Reopen Bulk Operations.
testCases.then: Job is still processing or completed. It did not die with the browser.
testCases.description:
Given: A verification job can be started.
When: Start Verification, then close the tab or go to Posts. Wait ~30–60s. Reopen Bulk Operations.
testCases.expectedResult: Job is still processing or completed. It did not die with the browser.
testCases.purpose: Verification must complete server-side — operators close the tab during long runs.
testCases.failImpact: Large libraries never finish verify on hosts without reliable loopback workers.

testCases.title: Pause / Resume / Cancel on verification
testCases.given: A verification job with enough files that it does not finish instantly (use a larger library or pause quickly).
testCases.when: 1. Click Pause → status paused, progress bar stops chewing new files (in-flight items may finish). 2. Click Resume → continues from remaining items. 3. On another run (or remaining items): click Cancel → remaining pending items cancelled; cancelled items are not verified afterward.
testCases.then: Each control matches the status in the table. Cancelled files stay Offloaded (not Verified) unless they already succeeded.
testCases.description:
Given: A verification job with enough files that it does not finish instantly (use a larger library or pause quickly).
When: 1. Click Pause → status paused, progress bar stops chewing new files (in-flight items may finish). 2. Click Resume → continues from remaining items. 3. On another run (or remaining items): click Cancel → remaining pending items cancelled; cancelled items are not verified afterward.
testCases.expectedResult: Each control matches the status in the table. Cancelled files stay Offloaded (not Verified) unless they already succeeded.
testCases.purpose: Long verify jobs must be operable — pause for maintenance, cancel mistaken runs without corrupting state.

testCases.title: Success updates Media Library + Dashboard
testCases.where: After a successful verify → Media → Library (list) and Dashboard
testCases.given: A file was verified (VERIFIED-1).
testCases.when: Open a file that was verified. Refresh Dashboard.
testCases.then: Lifecycle = Verified. Dashboard Verified count went up. Awaiting verification went down. If awaiting is now 0, the Dashboard warning improves or clears.
testCases.description:
Given: A file was verified (VERIFIED-1).
When: Open a file that was verified. Refresh Dashboard.
testCases.expectedResult: Lifecycle = Verified. Dashboard Verified count went up. Awaiting verification went down. If awaiting is now 0, the Dashboard warning improves or clears.
testCases.purpose: Successful verify must propagate lifecycle Verified to Media Library and Dashboard counts in sync (G1).
testCases.failImpact: Verified in job table but still “awaiting verification” in UI.

testCases.title: Real verification failure is visible
testCases.where: File Manager or bucket console, then Bulk Operations → Start Verification
testCases.given: File TO-FAIL is offloaded in WP, but you deleted the cloud object (or replaced it with a different-size file).
testCases.when: Run Start Verification. When done, open Media Library details for that file. Optionally View failures on the job.
testCases.then: Lifecycle = Failed. You can see a plain-language reason (missing object, size mismatch, URL check, etc.). Dashboard Failed > 0. Verification CSV reason / code matches that file. Site still loads other media; one failed verify does not take the site down.
testCases.description:
Given: File TO-FAIL is offloaded in WP, but you deleted the cloud object (or replaced it with a different-size file).
When: Run Start Verification. When done, open Media Library details for that file. Optionally View failures on the job.
testCases.expectedResult: Lifecycle = Failed. You can see a plain-language reason (missing object, size mismatch, URL check, etc.). Dashboard Failed > 0. Verification CSV reason / code matches that file. Site still loads other media; one failed verify does not take the site down.
testCases.purpose: Core v6.2.0 regression. When cloud object is gone, verify must set Failed everywhere — not keep false “healthy offloaded” counts or broken cloud URLs (G2, G1, G3).
testCases.failImpact: Dashboard shows 27/27 offloaded; Media Library not bannered; site serves 404 cloud URL — exact pre-release bug.

testCases.title: Verify is blocked while Remove is running
testCases.given: A Start Durable Remove job is processing or paused.
testCases.when: Look at Start Verification.
testCases.then: Button is disabled / reads Blocked by Remove job. Tooltip explains wait. No second conflicting job is created.
testCases.description:
Given: A Start Durable Remove job is processing or paused.
When: Look at Start Verification.
testCases.expectedResult: Button is disabled / reads Blocked by Remove job. Tooltip explains wait. No second conflicting job is created.
testCases.purpose: Concurrent Remove + Verify must not corrupt metadata or race the same attachments.

testCases.title: Double-click does not start two verify jobs
testCases.when: Click the button twice quickly.
testCases.then: One job only. Second click says verification is already running (or already active but paused — resume from the job list).
testCases.description: When: Click the button twice quickly.
testCases.expectedResult: One job only. Second click says verification is already running (or already active but paused — resume from the job list).
testCases.purpose: Accidental double-click must not spawn duplicate verify jobs processing the same library twice.

testCases.title: Remove is blocked while Verify is running
testCases.given: Verification job active.
testCases.when: Look at Start Durable Remove.
testCases.then: Disabled / Blocked by Verify job. Confirm dialog for remove is not the path to a second job.
testCases.description:
Given: Verification job active.
When: Look at Start Durable Remove.
testCases.expectedResult: Disabled / Blocked by Verify job. Confirm dialog for remove is not the path to a second job.
testCases.purpose: Mutex in reverse direction — Remove cannot start during active Verify.

sections.purpose: Start Verification must run a real durable job that updates lifecycle metadata, survives navigation, and reports failures honestly (G4). Critical regression: jobs stuck at 0% or duplicate jobs.
